name: Buffer
label: Buffer GraphQL — organizations, channels, posts
description: Official Buffer GraphQL API at https://api.buffer.com. Docs: https://developers.buffer.com/guides/posts-and-scheduling.html. POST / with {query, variables}. post_create takes text, channelId, schedulingType, mode, dueAt (nested into variables.input). Bearer access_token. Never log the token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: GraphQL query plus purpose-oriented variables. post_create: text, channelId, schedulingType, mode. Do not put access_token here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which GraphQL call this invoke represents. EXACT: organization_list | channel_list | post_create | post_list. The HTTP path is always POST /. Example: post_create.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Official GraphQL document (body `query`). When empty, send a document that matches the operation (see README). Example: mutation($input: CreatePostInput!) { createPost(input: $input) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id } } ... on MutationError { message } } }.

schema.label: organizationId
schema.description: Buffer organization id. channel_list / post_list: variables.input.organizationId. Example: org_123.

schema.label: channelId
schema.description: Buffer channel id (connected social profile). post_create required variables.input.channelId. Example: channel_456.

schema.label: text
schema.description: post_create required post text (variables.input.text). Example: Hello from Buffer.

schema.label: schedulingType
schema.description: post_create variables.input.schedulingType. Official: automatic. Example: automatic.

schema.label: mode
schema.description: post_create variables.input.mode. Official examples: addToQueue | shareNow | customScheduled. Example: addToQueue.

schema.label: dueAt
schema.description: post_create variables.input.dueAt (ISO-8601 UTC) when mode is customScheduled. Example: 2026-11-01T15:00:00.000Z.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (GraphQL JSON). HTTP 200 may still contain errors[]. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx. Inspect data.errors and MutationError unions.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: organization_list | channel_list | post_create | post_list. All four POST https://api.buffer.com with the INPUT JSON as the body.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Buffer personal API key or OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
